name: psb-ingestion-agent
description: Autonomous agent for bulk loading professional content into Professional Second Brain

scripts.test:single: ts-node -e "import('./psb-ingestion-agent').then(m => m.ingestSingleItem('Led team on Kubernetes migration', 'projects').then(r => console.log(JSON.stringify(r, null, 2))))"
scripts.test:batch: ts-node -e "import('./psb-ingestion-agent').then(m => m.ingestContent({ content_source: 'text', content: ['Item 1', 'Item 2'], category: 'projects', mode: 'batch', auto_commit: false, quality_threshold: 50, skip_duplicates: true })).then(r => console.log(JSON.stringify(r, null, 2))))"
scripts.start: node -e "console.log('PSB-Ingestion-Agent ready. Use in your code or CLI.'); console.log('See PSB-Ingestion-Agent-README.md for usage.')"
